scenes.title: Keep a valid range when a gesture is reversed

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Start at step two
steps.caption: Hold start 2, press and release end 4, then release start. The channel repeats D, E and F with its original gates.

steps.title: Reject a reversed end
steps.caption: Holding step 4 and releasing step 2 reports “End must follow start”. The prior grid range remains unchanged.

steps.title: Choose a valid range again
steps.caption: The next valid gesture selects steps 3–4; MIDI confirms E and F, with the same step timing and gates.

scenes.title: Mute and bring a running phrase back

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Bring channel one back
steps.caption: After the long channel hold silences the running channel and releases its notes, K1 plus the channel button unmutes it. The bright channel indicator returns; emitted notes continue the unchanged four-note phrase.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Start with X
steps.caption: Assign Chord Note Strum to a Trig params slot. X leaves strumming off.

steps.title: First supported division
steps.caption: One E3 detent from X selects 1/24. This is a fraction of the channel step.

steps.title: Upper bound
steps.caption: Turning past the supported upper end keeps the visible value at 128.

steps.title: One step down
steps.caption: A reverse detent moves from 128 to the next supported value, 120.

scenes.title: Ten parameter slots keep their own routes

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: The first and last slots
steps.caption: After assigning ten CC slots, E2 clamps at each end. Held step locks still send CC10 on step one and CC1 on step two before their notes; exact gates and releases are checked.

scenes.title: Transpose the next note without cutting the current one

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Live transpose edits
steps.caption: Two global transpose edits are made while notes sound. Existing pitches and gates survive; subsequent onsets use the new transpose, remain on the timing lattice and receive matching Note Off messages.

scenes.title: Let a keyboard follow the scale

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Raw notes by default
steps.caption: With white-key mapping off, all 128 input keys emit their original MIDI pitches and matching releases.

steps.title: White keys follow Major
steps.caption: Enable Map scale to white keys: the C-major scale follows the white keys. The case verifies every input pitch. Black-key handling is characterised by the case rather than promised by this manual.

steps.title: A new scale changes the mapping
steps.caption: Choose natural minor, return to the channel, and play the next keyboard octave. Its exact mapped pitches follow the new scale.

steps.title: Turn mapping off
steps.caption: Disable mapping to restore the raw MIDI pitches across the tested octave, with no active notes left behind.

scenes.title: Loop a song group or hold one slot

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Empty slots close the group
steps.caption: With Song mode on, filled slots 1 and 2 repeat as a group because slot 3 is empty. Each slot sounds its distinctive two-note octave.

steps.title: Select the next slot while playing
steps.caption: A live selection of slot 2 waits for slot 4 to finish, then joins the first group. Exact note order verifies the boundary.

steps.title: Song mode off holds the slot
steps.caption: With Song mode off, slot 1 keeps repeating rather than advancing automatically.

steps.title: Manual selection still works
steps.caption: Song mode off still honours a queued manual selection: finish slot 1, then keep playing slot 2.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Choose Foundation
steps.caption: Foundation adds attacks on steps 5 and 7 with velocity 70. Strategy and Active read FOUNDATION.

steps.title: Switch to All
steps.caption: All restores the pattern's own additions on steps 5 and 7 at velocity 100. Listen for the louder accents.

steps.title: Return to Skip
steps.caption: Choose Skip in the same Strategy list. Strategy and Active read SKIP, the footer confirms SKIP APPLIED, and the merge indicator dims.

scenes.title: See a failed voicing and choose a fallback

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: No legal register
steps.caption: An infeasible Pattern register shows NO VOICING RANGE. The mapped tone is silent and Result exposes the failure details.

steps.title: An unrecorded step has no event
steps.caption: Inspect step 5: Status and the channel voice both read NO EVENT. It is not presented as another failed voicing.

steps.title: Choose Legacy explicitly
steps.caption: Change Failure fallback to LEGACY and apply it. The original C/D/E/F phrase plays again; the Result status reads LEGACY RANGE.
